Introduction

E'LAST is a seven-member boy group under E Entertainment. They debuted on June 9, 2020 with their first mini album Day Dream.

Their name is an abbreviation of "Everlasting", which either means "Eternity" and "Infinity."

On June 22, Seung Yeop (Now Known as Yoon Suho) announced during an Instagram livestream that he had left the group due to his contract with E Entertainment concluding.
